items.title: David Spinozza interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, NY, September 27, 2025
items.q: Paul brought me and Kenny Asher over to augment this... we were going to play a couple of shows, her TV show

ctx.x: Peter, Paul & Mary. Yeah. So she had a TV show in England. So Paul brought me and Kenny Asher over to augment this – we were going to get a bass player and a thing – we’re going to play a couple of shows, her TV show and something else. And when we got to the studio a union delegate, an English union delegate comes in and says, “You guys can’t play on the TV show” to me and Kenny Asher. And I said, “Why not?” He said, “Well there has to be the same amount of musicians – you know we have to have a piano player and…
You can’t make this stuff up.
